document_versions_extracting_lease_chk.name: document_versions_extracting_lease_chk
document_versions_extracting_lease_chk.value: (status = 'extracting') = (active_run_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND worker_id IS NOT NULL)

document_versions_last_error_code_chk.name: document_versions_last_error_code_chk
document_versions_last_error_code_chk.value: last_error_code IS NULL OR last_error_code IN ('PARSE_ENCRYPTED', 'PARSE_MALFORMED', 'PARSE_TIMEOUT', 'PARSE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'PARSE_NO_TEXT', 'PARSE_CRASHED', 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'INTEGRITY_MISMATCH', 'LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED', 'LLM_AUTH', 'LLM_BAD_REQUEST', 'LLM_SCHEMA_INVALID', 'LLM_TRUNCATED', 'LLM_REFUSED', 'LLM_RATE_CAPPED', 'LLM_CALL_CAP', 'MAX_ATTEMPTS', 'DOCUMENT_DELETED')

document_versions_extracted_text_chk.name: document_versions_extracted_text_chk
document_versions_extracted_text_chk.value: status <> 'extracted' OR parsed_text IS NOT NULL

documents_deleted_reason_chk.name: documents_deleted_reason_chk
documents_deleted_reason_chk.value: deleted_reason IS NULL OR (deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND char_length(deleted_reason) <= 500)

documents_deleted_request_id_chk.name: documents_deleted_request_id_chk
documents_deleted_request_id_chk.value: deleted_request_id IS NULL OR deleted_at IS NOT NULL

llm_calls_chunk_index_chk.name: llm_calls_chunk_index_chk
llm_calls_chunk_index_chk.value: (kind = 'chunk') = (chunk_index IS NOT NULL) AND (chunk_index IS NULL OR chunk_index >= 0)

extracted_values_match_mode_chk.name: extracted_values_match_mode_chk
extracted_values_match_mode_chk.value: match_mode IS NULL OR match_mode IN ('strict', 'quote_folded')

extracted_values_gap_code_chk.name: extracted_values_gap_code_chk
extracted_values_gap_code_chk.value: gap_code IS NULL OR gap_code IN ('NOT_FOUND', 'MODEL_OMITTED', 'EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_TEXT', 'VALUE_NOT_SUPPORTED', 'UNPARSEABLE_VALUE', 'EVIDENCE_HIDDEN', 'CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE')

extracted_values_change_reason_chk.name: extracted_values_change_reason_chk
extracted_values_change_reason_chk.value: (change_kind = 'changed') = (change_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (change_reason IS NULL OR change_reason IN ('VALUE_CHANGED', 'EVIDENCE_CHANGED', 'GAP_INVOLVED', 'WEAK_EVIDENCE_LINE', 'PARSER_CHANGED', 'POSSIBLE_AMENDMENT', 'CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE', 'EVIDENCE_HIDDEN', 'TYPE_CHANGED'))

extracted_values_gap_and_value_shape_chk.name: extracted_values_gap_and_value_shape_chk
extracted_values_gap_and_value_shape_chk.value:
(
        (kind = 'gap'
          AND value IS NULL
          AND evidence IS NULL
          AND canonical_evidence IS NULL
          AND gap_code IS NOT NULL
          AND gap_reason IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        (kind = 'value'
          AND gap_code IS NULL
          AND gap_reason IS NULL
          AND evidence IS NOT NULL
          AND canonical_evidence IS NOT NULL
          AND (
    (field_type = 'string'
      AND jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'
      AND char_length(value #>> '{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 2000
      AND char_length(btrim(value #>> '{}')) >= 1)
    OR (field_type = 'date'
      AND jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'
      AND (value #>> '{}') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$')
    OR (field_type = 'money'
      AND jsonb_typeof(value) = 'object'
      AND jsonb_typeof(value -> 'amount') = 'string'
      AND jsonb_typeof(value -> 'currency') = 'string'
      AND (value - 'amount' - 'currency') = '{}'::jsonb
      AND (value ->> 'amount') ~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]*[1-9])?$'
      AND (value ->> 'currency') ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
    OR (field_type IN ('number', 'percent')
      AND jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'
      AND (value #>> '{}') ~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]*[1-9])?$')
  ))
      )

reviews_corrected_value_chk.name: reviews_corrected_value_chk
reviews_corrected_value_chk.value:
(decision = 'correct') = (corrected_value IS NOT NULL) AND (corrected_value IS NULL OR (
    (field_type = 'string'
      AND jsonb_typeof(corrected_value) = 'string'
      AND char_length(corrected_value #>> '{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 2000
      AND char_length(btrim(corrected_value #>> '{}')) >= 1)
    OR (field_type = 'date'
      AND jsonb_typeof(corrected_value) = 'string'
      AND (corrected_value #>> '{}') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$')
    OR (field_type = 'money'
      AND jsonb_typeof(corrected_value) = 'object'
      AND jsonb_typeof(corrected_value -> 'amount') = 'string'
      AND jsonb_typeof(corrected_value -> 'currency') = 'string'
      AND (corrected_value - 'amount' - 'currency') = '{}'::jsonb
      AND (corrected_value ->> 'amount') ~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]*[1-9])?$'
      AND (corrected_value ->> 'currency') ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
    OR (field_type IN ('number', 'percent')
      AND jsonb_typeof(corrected_value) = 'string'
      AND (corrected_value #>> '{}') ~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]*[1-9])?$')
  ))
